faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the MPSC Deputy Medical Superintendent recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your online application for the MPSC Deputy Medical Superintendent posts is 29th September 2026. Ensure all details are accurate before the deadline.

faq.question: Q2. What are the minimum and maximum age limits for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The minimum age requirement is 18 years, and the maximum age limit is 45 years for most categories. Age relaxations are available for specific reserved categories and ex-servicemen.

faq.question: Q3. What is the educational qualification required for the Deputy Medical Superintendent post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess an MBBS degree from a recognized university along with a postgraduate degree or diploma in Hospital Administration. Distance education qualifications are not accepted.

faq.question: Q4. How many vacancies are available for the Deputy Medical Superintendent post?
faq.answer: There are a total of 2 vacancies announced for the Deputy Medical Superintendent position in this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q5. What is the application fee for the MPSC recruitment?
faq.answer: The application fee for Unreserved (UR) category candidates is Rs. 719. For OBC, EWS, Orphan, and Disabled candidates, the fee is Rs. 449.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary structure for the Deputy Medical Superintendent post?
faq.answer: Selected candidates will be placed in Pay Matrix Level M37, with a salary ranging from Rs. 71,100 to Rs. 2,11,900, along with applicable allowances.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for this MPSC recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection process will involve a Written Examination, which serves as a screening test, followed by an Interview for the shortlisted candidates.

faq.question: Q8. Is there any work experience required for this post?
faq.answer: Yes, candidates must have at least 5 years of experience in a responsible position equivalent to that of a Chief Medical Officer in the Public Health Department of Brihanmumbai Municipal Corporation.

faq.question: Q9. How can I apply for the MPSC Deputy Medical Superintendent recruitment?
faq.answer: Applications must be submitted online through the MPSC official website. Candidates need to register, complete KYC, fill the form, upload documents, and pay the fee by the last date.

faq.question: Q10. Do I need to be registered with the Maharashtra Medical Council?
faq.answer: Yes, it is mandatory for all applicants to be registered with the Maharashtra Medical Council to be eligible for the Deputy Medical Superintendent post.
